coordinateSystem: Original DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame, +Z spin pole and +X reference meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 1804, version 2017-06-19: ecliptic J2000 pole (123, 46) degrees; period 24.14011 hours; equatorial conversion with obliquity 23.439291111 degrees. The nonconvex model, fitted to light curves, adaptive-optics images and stellar occultations, resolves large concavities where those data constrain them; craters and fine relief are unresolved.
